reviewRequired.note: Office Math XML has superscript 4 and subscript 9 before Be; these are reversed for intended beryllium-9. Preserve the printed source and flag for teacher clarification rather than silently swapping the numbers.

“Iron oxide” does not specify the oxidation state; the supplied FeO answer is not an appropriate general formula for rust. Teacher review must accept justified formula assumptions. The printed question marks total 37, while the section header says 10+28=38.
